# NEXUS — The Harmonic Reality Framework

> Public research interface of Dean A. Kulik, QuHarmonics Research Group. Native binary rings, continuation, reversible reader–field operations, and compiler interfaces.

Use the exact source revisions and method scopes. An OPEN binding is not a completed provider; a recorded execution is not a claim outside its declared scope. The historical catalog is not the current active checkout. Existing file-specific licenses govern reuse.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Method registry](methods.json): initial mathematical method contracts, dependencies, return routes and pinned source revision.
- [Historical catalog](catalog.json): original file paths, object identifiers and source revision.
- [RO-Crate research metadata](https://github.com/QuHarmonics/The-Nexus-Harmonic-Reality/blob/main/ro-crate-metadata.json): selected research objects and attribution.
- [Verification code](https://github.com/QuHarmonics/The-Nexus-Harmonic-Reality/blob/main/tools/verify_research.py): finite checks and metadata/source-link validation.
